body:
## Pull request overview This PR updates Unicode-related data files and fetch scripts from version 16.0.0 to version 17.0.0. The changes update URLs in Python fetch scripts and regenerate Unicode character data tables including character ranges, case conversion mappings, and Unicode block definitions. **Changes:** - Updated fetch script URLs to reference Unicode 17.0.0 instead of 16.0.0 - Regenerated Unicode data tables with new character ranges and case mappings - Added new Unicode blocks: Sidetic, Sharada Supplement, Tolong Siki, Beria Erfe, Tangut Components Supplement, Miscellaneous Symbols Supplement, Tai Yo, and CJK Unified Ideographs Extension J ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | misc/scripts/unicode_ranges_fetch.py | Updated URL to fetch Unicode 17.0.0 block data | | misc/scripts/ucaps_fetch.py | Updated URL to fetch Unicode 17.0.0 case conversion data | | misc/scripts/char_range_fetch.py | Updated URL to fetch Unicode 17.0.0 derived properties data | | editor/import/unicode_ranges.inc | Regenerated Unicode block ranges with 9 new blocks added | | core/string/ucaps.h | Regenerated case conversion tables with 31 new Beria Erfe character mappings and increased table sizes | | core/string/char_range.inc | Regenerated character property ranges with updated character classifications and ranges |
